description: Land Title Settlement Department - Manampitiya, Dimbulagala, D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120102 (24/0534)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of multiple land parcels in Manampitiya, including detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, extents, ownership status (all owned by "The State"), and possession/license details. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
